service.description: The registered instance settings (moqui.server.InstanceSetting) with their effective values: each with its key, title, group, type, allowed values or limits, value, source (preference: an instance preference; configuration: the deployment's conf or environment; default), whether it is editable here and by the caller, whether a change of its conf value waits for a restart, the operator's note, and for a preference its revision and who changed it, when and why. A secret is masked: value null, valueSet whether it is set. Narrowed by settingGroup, kind (preference or configuration) and settingKey. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_VIEW; with ADMIN_ACCESS_VIEW alone, the sign-in settings only (the groups Sign-in and Sign-in policy), which the access administrator reads beside the groups' sign-in rules.

The effective value of one registered instance preference, for the code that uses it (the report engine's group recipient ceiling, the new-device sign-in window): the stored preference, else the conf property its registration names, else its registered default; numberValue for a whole number. An error for a key that is not a registered preference. A preference is nonsecret by registration, so no permission is needed.

The value of one registered instance preference, as its registration types and limits it, at the revision read (expectedRevision as get#EffectiveSettings gives it, empty when none is set); an empty value removes the preference, so the conf property or the default applies again. Refused, with the reason, for a key that is not a registered preference (NOT_REGISTERED), a value outside its type, allowed values or limits (VALUE_INVALID) and a stale revision (STALE_REVISION). Who, when and why are kept on the row and each value in the audit log. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_MANAGE and the setting's own manage permission, if it names one.

The sign-in policy the server runs with (impl-admin P10, F110): a fixed list of nonsecret conf attributes no property holds, each by its key (user-facade/password/@min-length and the other password minimums, history and change rules; user-facade/login-key/@expire-hours and device-expire-hours; user-facade/login/@max-failures, disable-minutes and history-store; webapp/session-config/@timeout) with the conf's value, else the one the code falls back to. get#EffectiveSettings shows them through the settings that name one as confAttribute. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_VIEW or ADMIN_ACCESS_VIEW.

The message translations (moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage), by locale and text (original or translation, ignoring case), a page at a time, each with its revision; with missing and a locale, the originals translated in another locale and not in this one (truncated when more were found than are read). Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_VIEW.

The translation of a message in a locale, at the revision read (empty for a new one); empty removes it. Refused, with the reason, when the translation does not keep exactly the original's ${} placeholders (PLACEHOLDER_MISMATCH), for an original that is a link, a path or a link type or whose ${} values are more than names and simple calls (PLACEHOLDER_UNSUPPORTED: Tools', an instance administrator's), for a locale that is not one (LOCALE_INVALID) and for a stale revision (STALE_REVISION); markup and a link are not accepted. The audit log keeps the text before and after. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_MANAGE.

The label translations (moqui.basic.LocalizedEntityField) of the registered label targets (moqui.basic.LocalizedLabelTarget, targetList), by target (targetKey, the entity and field), locale and text, a page at a time, each with the label it translates and its revision; with missing, a target and a locale, that target's labels with no translation in the locale. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_VIEW.

The translation of one label (pkValue) of a registered label target in a locale (or default, the fallback of every locale), at the revision read; empty removes it. Refused, with the reason, for an entity field that is not a registered label target (NOT_REGISTERED), a label that does not exist (LABEL_UNAVAILABLE), a translation that does not keep the label's ${} placeholders (PLACEHOLDER_MISMATCH; PLACEHOLDER_UNSUPPORTED as store#LocalizedMessage), a locale that is not one (LOCALE_INVALID) and a stale revision (STALE_REVISION). The audit log keeps the text before and after. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_MANAGE.

The sign-in providers: each with its name, type, whether it is enabled, its readiness (enabled, untested, tested, needsTest, incomplete, unavailable for SAML, inbound) and the callback URL to register at the provider; narrowed by text, type and state (enabled or disabled). With authFlowId, that provider alone (provider): its configuration with each secret as whether it is set, never its value, its identity mappings (an expression or a mapping service marked advanced, never shown), its role mappings each with whether a sign-in may give the group and why not, its link rule and default group, its revision, and the options its forms offer (the groups only for a caller who may map them). Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW or ADMIN_ACCESS_VIEW.

A new sign-in provider (no authFlowId, or a new one; OpenID Connect or OAuth; saved disabled), or changes of one at the revision read (expectedRevision as find#IdentityProviders gives it); only what is given changes. The configuration (name, icon, order, the type's fields, a secret, the identity mappings: a claim name onto the full name, email address, locale or time zone, never an expression) needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE; the role mappings, the default group, the link rule and enabling need ADMIN_ACCESS_MANAGE. Refused, with the reason and nothing written: a stale revision (STALE_REVISION); a mapped or default group the actor may not assign, a privileged group or one granting a sealed permission (UNREGISTERED_BUNDLE, NOT_DELEGABLE, PRIVILEGED_GROUP, SEALED_PERMISSION; roleMapList names each); enabling without a passing test of the configuration as it is now (TEST_REQUIRED), or while a linked account holds access beyond the actor's (HELD_BEYOND); disabling the provider the last administrator signs in by (ADMINISTRATION_PATH); an inbound flow (UNSUPPORTED_PROVIDER); SAML enabled, or another type started (UNSUPPORTED_TYPE); identity mappings an instance administrator wrote as expressions (ADVANCED_MAPPING). A change of the client type, client id, issuer, discovery or metadata URL, realm, an endpoint or the Apple team or key needs the secret entered again in the same save, else the stored one is cleared (secretCleared); either way the provider is saved disabled and its test mark cleared (design-admin §8.1), with the reason saying so, as a change of the token signature or the nonce does with the secret kept. URLs are https (http only for the server's own machine on an instance that is not production). The audit log keeps before and after, a secret as replaced or cleared, never its value.

parameter.name: authFlowTypeEnumId
parameter.description: For a new provider: AftOidc or AftOauth

parameter.name: secret
parameter.description: Write-only: the client secret (Apple: the private key), replaced when given

parameter.name: fieldMapList
parameter.description: When given, every identity mapping: each {srcFieldName, dstFieldName}

parameter.name: roleMapList
parameter.description: When given, every role mapping: each {roleName, userGroupId}

parameter.name: enabled
parameter.description: true to enable, false to disable

service.description: The explicit check of a provider as it is configured now, enabled or not (checkList, each ok or failed with its text): the configuration is complete, every mapped and default group may still be given by a sign-in, and a sign-in could start (org.moqui.sso.AuthServices.check#Flow: an OpenID provider's discovery document is read and the client built as a sign-in builds it). No account is made, nobody is signed in and no token is asked for; a failure's text names URLs and never a secret or a token. A pass is marked on the provider for the configuration it ran against, which enabling requires; a failure clears the mark and leaves the provider as it was. With testRoles, the roles of a test identity, grantPreview says which group each would give. callbackUrl is the redirect URI to register at the provider. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE or ADMIN_ACCESS_MANAGE.

parameter.name: testRoles
parameter.description: Comma or space separated, or a List
